meta.name: baoyu-url-to-markdown
meta.description: Fetch any URL and convert to markdown using Chrome CDP. Supports two modes - auto-capture on page load, or wait for user signal (for pages requiring login). Use when user wants to save a webpage as markdown.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意网页转为 Markdown 格式保存
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把网页内容保存为 Markdown 格式
copy.tagline_en: Convert any webpage to Markdown format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to save web pages as Markdown

howto.what: Claude 可根据你给的网址,用 Chrome 抓取网页内容,转成带标题、网址等信息的 Markdown 文件并保存。默认页面加载完自动完成;需登录的页面可改用等待模式。
howto.when: 当用户想把某个网页保存为 Markdown 时触发;需登录的页面可要求用等待模式。

say.text: 把 https://example.com 保存成 Markdown

say.note: 会等你确认页面就绪再抓取。

say.text: 把这个网页转成 Markdown,存到 output.md

howto.what_en: Claude can fetch any URL via Chrome, convert the HTML into clean Markdown with metadata (title, URL, etc.), and save it locally. It captures automatically on page load by default, or uses wait mode for login-required pages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to save a webpage as Markdown. For complex pages like login-required ones, the user can ask for wait mode.

say_en.text: Use wait mode to save https://example.com.
say_en.note: Waits for your ready signal before capturing.

say_en.text: Convert this webpage to Markdown and save to output.md.
